verdict.rationale: The search API reference response schema includes a "subpages" field alongside per-result content [exa-docs-37]. This suggests Exa can return linked subpages for a search result. The Contents API also fetches clean page content from given URLs [exa-docs-24], but it is not documented as a subpage crawl. Domain and path-prefix filters [exa-docs-5, exa-docs-13] only restrict search results and are not crawling, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: documentation of subpage crawl parameters (depth, count, link targeting), any whole-site crawl capability, usage examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.
